findings.location: FastAPI API and Error Model endpoint table; Frontend Architecture / VerdictCard
findings.problem: GET /reviews/{review_id} is specified to return both a bare ClashReport and a ReviewReportResponse envelope.
findings.fix: Choose ReviewReportResponse { report: ClashReport, candidates: list[ReviewCandidateDetail] } as the sole response model and update the endpoint table, server, parser, and tests.

findings.location: Cached Demo Service; FastAPI API and Error Model
findings.problem: Review execution is assigned to the events stream, while cache/provider errors are assigned to POST review creation; concurrent pending stream and replay/failure behavior is undefined.
findings.fix: Persist PENDING/RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED state and atomically claim execution; define POST, concurrent stream, completed replay, and failed-review terminal behavior consistently.

findings.location: Shared Contracts and Persistence; Data Pipeline, Providers, and Retrieval; Cached Demo Service
findings.problem: Regex-shaped canonical IDs are not validated against an authoritative city, district, or project registry, despite unknown-ID requirements.
findings.fix: Define read-only validated district/project registries, city-ID semantics, endpoint rejection statuses, and cache-reference validation rules.

findings.problem: The final retrieval filter names, date-window shape, one-sided-window semantics, and validation responses are unspecified.
findings.fix: Define one Pydantic SearchRequest with k <= 8, city_id, optional district_id, sector, and named implementation_start/implementation_end fields plus explicit interval rules.

findings.location: Shared Contracts and Persistence; Cached Demo Service
findings.problem: The canonical cache proposal identity/content guard and fingerprint serialization are not defined.
findings.fix: Store the exact ProposalCreate and a documented SHA-256 canonical JSON fingerprint in the cache; require exact equality before assigning demo-proposal-01 and test altered/missing fields.
